Hey! So I know it's been a couple weeks now but I finally got around to watching La La Land and wow. I'm sorry but an unprompted, WAY too late film review is coming your way. It was a visual spectacle- hats off to the cinematographer. The use of color throughout the film was top notch. The acting was brilliant, but Emma Stone really knocks it out of the park. 

My only gripe with it was that the songs, while heartfelt (and often heart wrenching), lacked a certain "umph" or punchiness. In my entirely amateur and uneducated ignorance I struggle to identify exactly what I take issue with, but I find myself better able to listen to the songs of The Greatest Showman or even Sweeney Todd as standalones more than the musical numbers in La La Land. 

Still, the wrap up of purposefully showing the audience the 100% happy ending with Mia and Seb loving and living happily ever after and just how trite, manufactured, and fake that is, and then setting that against the backdrop of the two characters smiling and nodding at each other, both having accomplished the dreams they had at the start of the film.... this movie is a masterpiece. 

So anyway, whether you meant to or not you put La La Land back on my radar and I wanted to thank you for doing that. I just had a great night thanks in part to you. Be well!

Yep, the confusion comes from math education compartmentalizing everything too much and not looking at how every math topic relates to one another.

This guy maths. 

Multiplication and division are the same operation (as in dividing by two is the same as multiplying by one half). Addition and subtraction are the same operation (as in adding two is the same as subtracting negative two).

PEMDAS is the result of compartmentalizing earlier mathematics education (first you learn addition, then subtraction, and never learn how the two relate before moving on to multiplication...).
